description: Lower ground floor rear extension, new windows, internal alterations including internal wall insulation to external walls and the erection of an Air Source Heat Pump
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Prior to commencement of development, details of the windows for the proposed extension and for the replacement windows to the existing dwelling, to include sectional details at scales 1:5 and 1:20 showing sash profiling, shall be submitted to the local planning authority for approval. &nbsp; The development shall subsequently be carried out in accordance with the approved details. </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON:&nbsp; In the interests of visual amenity and to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area.</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">Tree protection for all retained trees at the site and on adjacent land shall be undertaken in accordance with BS5837:2012 (Trees in relation to construction - Recommendations) and will protect the root protection area calculated as described in Table 2 of that British Standard for the duration of all site works (including demolition) undertaken in connection with the development hereby approved.&nbsp; Tree Protection will be in accordance with the approved Tree Protection Plan (DWG NO. OAS 26-116-TS03).</span><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">REASON: To safeguard existing tree(s) in the interests of visual amenity, having regard to Policy LP51 in the Local Plan 2033 (adopted 2020) and pursuant to Section 197 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.</span></p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall ensure that the rating level of noise emissions from the ASHP does not exceed 5dB below the background noise level at the nearest residential receptor, in accordance with BS4142:2014+A1:2019. Should any changes to the approved plant or equipment occur, a noise assessment must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate compliance with BS4142:2014+A1:2019. REASON: To safeguard the amenity of neighbouring occupiers and ensure compliance with Policy LP2 of Hackney’s Local Plan and the London Plan’s strategic noise policies.</p>
